```{r setup, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
draw_label_theme <- function(label, theme = NULL, element = "text", ...) {
  if (is.null(theme)) {
    theme <- ggplot2::theme_get()
  }
  if (!element %in% names(theme)) {
    stop("Element must be a valid ggplot theme element name")
  }

  elements <- ggplot2::calc_element(element, theme)

  cowplot::draw_label(label, 
                      fontfamily = elements$family,
                      fontface = elements$face,
                      colour = elements$color,
                      size = elements$size,
                      ...
  )
}
```

# a. plot umaps of all 78k cells separated by subject
```{r per subject umap, fig.align='center', fig.width= 18, fig.height= 6}

# downsample
set.seed(1000)

table(refmapped.all$phenotype)

Idents(refmapped.all) <- 'phenotype'
cell.list.para <- WhichCells(refmapped.all, idents= "Parasitemic", downsample = 40989)

cell.list.apara <- WhichCells(refmapped.all, idents= "Aparasitemic")

cell.list <- c(cell.list.apara, cell.list.para)

refmapped.all.downsampled <- refmapped.all[, cell.list]

Idents(refmapped.all.downsampled) <- 'seurat_clusters'


Idents(refmapped.all.downsampled)<-refmapped.all.downsampled$phenotype
aparacells<-WhichCells(refmapped.all.downsampled, idents = "Aparasitemic")
paracells<-WhichCells(refmapped.all.downsampled, idents = "Parasitemic")


apara_umap <- DimPlot(refmapped.all.downsampled,  pt.size = 3.5, reduction = "ref.umap", cells = aparacells, alpha = 0.45, combine = FALSE, group.by = "predicted.celltype.l2")[[1]]$data %>%
  mutate(class = "aparasitemic") 

para_umap <- DimPlot(refmapped.all.downsampled,  pt.size = 3.5, reduction = "ref.umap",  cells = paracells, alpha = 0.45, combine = FALSE, group.by = "predicted.celltype.l2")[[1]]$data %>%
  mutate(class = "parasitemic") 

all_umap <- bind_rows(apara_umap,
                          para_umap) %>%
  mutate(class = factor(class, levels = c("parasitemic", "aparasitemic")))

library(ggh4x)
strip_apara <- strip_themed(background_y = elem_list_rect(fill = c( "#58a4cb", alpha = 0.6)))

strip_para <- strip_themed(background_y = elem_list_rect(fill = c( "#e41a1c", alpha = 0.6)))

cells_to_label <- c("CD14 Mono", "CD16 Mono", "CD4 Naive", "CD4 TEM", "CD8 Naive", "B memory", "B naive", "pDC", "cDC2", "CD8 TEM", "NK", "gdT", "MAIT",
                    "Treg", "NK_CD56bright")

all_umap$celltype_factor <- factor(all_umap$predicted.celltype.l2)
all_umap$celltype_num <- as.numeric(all_umap$celltype_factor)
legend_labels <- paste0(1:29, " - ", levels(all_umap$celltype_factor))


new_colors = colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(10,"Spectral"))(length(unique(all_umap$predicted.celltype.l2)))
find_center <- function(my_vector) my_vector[ceiling(length(my_vector)/2)]

all_umap <- all_umap %>%
  rownames_to_column(., "barcode")

all_umap_plot_bysubj_apara <- refmapped.all.downsampled@meta.data %>%
  rownames_to_column(., "barcode") %>%
  dplyr::select(c("subject_id", "barcode", "predicted.celltype.l2")) %>%
  left_join(all_umap, by="barcode") %>%
  group_by(class, predicted.celltype.l2.x, subject_id) %>%
  mutate(midval_umap1_by_celltype = find_center(UMAP_1)) %>%
  mutate(midval_umap2_by_celltype = find_center(UMAP_2)) %>%
  mutate(cell_label = as.character(celltype_num)) %>%
  mutate(label = ifelse(predicted.celltype.l2.x %in% cells_to_label & UMAP_1 == midval_umap1_by_celltype, cell_label, "")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(subj_id = ifelse(subject_id == "kali0585", "subject 1", subject_id)) %>%
  mutate(subj_id = ifelse(subj_id == "kali0618", "subject 2", subj_id)) %>%
  mutate(subj_id = ifelse(subj_id == "kali0631", "subject 4", subj_id)) %>%
  mutate(subj_id = ifelse(subj_id == "kali0626", "subject 3", subj_id)) %>%
  mutate(subj_id = ifelse(subj_id == "kali0636", "subject 5", subj_id)) %>%
  mutate(subj_id = ifelse(subj_id == "kali0647", "subject 6", subj_id)) %>%
  mutate(subj_id = ifelse(subj_id == "kali0666", "subject 7", subj_id)) %>%
  mutate(subj_id = ifelse(subj_id == "kali0593", "subject 8", subj_id)) %>%
  mutate(subj_id = ifelse(subj_id == "kali0600", "subject 9", subj_id)) %>%
    mutate(subj_id = ifelse(subj_id == "kali0604", "subject 10", subj_id)) %>%
  mutate(subj_id = ifelse(subj_id == "kali0628", "subject 11", subj_id)) %>%
  mutate(subj_id = ifelse(subj_id == "kali0640", "subject 12", subj_id)) %>%
  mutate(subj_id = ifelse(subj_id == "kali0650", "subject 13", subj_id)) %>%
  mutate(subj_id = ifelse(subj_id == "kali0651", "subject 14", subj_id)) %>%
  subset(class == "aparasitemic") %>% 
  ggplot(., aes(x = UMAP_1, y = UMAP_2, color = as.factor(celltype_num))) +
 geom_point(size = 0.5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = label), color = "black", size = 4) +
  xlab("UMAP 1") +
  ylab("UMAP 2") +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_color_manual(
    name = "Cell Type",
    values = new_colors,
    labels = legend_labels) +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        legend.margin = margin(),
        legend.spacing.y = unit(0.1, "cm"),
        legend.key.height = unit(0.75, "lines"),
        legend.text = element_blank(),
        plot.margin=unit(c(0.1,0.1,0.1,0.1), "null"),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 14)) +
  facet_grid2(rows = vars(class), cols = vars(factor(subj_id)), strip = strip_apara, independent = "all", scales = "free", space= "free")

all_umap_plot_bysubj_para <- refmapped.all.downsampled@meta.data %>%
  rownames_to_column(., "barcode") %>%
  dplyr::select(c("subject_id", "barcode", "predicted.celltype.l2")) %>%
  left_join(all_umap, by="barcode") %>%
  group_by(class, predicted.celltype.l2.x, subject_id) %>%
  mutate(midval_umap1_by_celltype = find_center(UMAP_1)) %>%
  mutate(midval_umap2_by_celltype = find_center(UMAP_2)) %>%
  mutate(cell_label = as.character(celltype_num)) %>%
  mutate(label = ifelse(predicted.celltype.l2.x %in% cells_to_label & UMAP_1 == midval_umap1_by_celltype, cell_label, "")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(subj_id = ifelse(subject_id == "kali0585", "subject 1", subject_id)) %>%
  mutate(subj_id = ifelse(subj_id == "kali0618", "subject 2", subj_id)) %>%
  mutate(subj_id = ifelse(subj_id == "kali0631", "subject 4", subj_id)) %>%
  mutate(subj_id = ifelse(subj_id == "kali0626", "subject 3", subj_id)) %>%
  mutate(subj_id = ifelse(subj_id == "kali0636", "subject 5", subj_id)) %>%
  mutate(subj_id = ifelse(subj_id == "kali0647", "subject 6", subj_id)) %>%
  mutate(subj_id = ifelse(subj_id == "kali0666", "subject 7", subj_id)) %>%
  mutate(subj_id = ifelse(subj_id == "kali0593", "subject 8", subj_id)) %>%
  mutate(subj_id = ifelse(subj_id == "kali0600", "subject 9", subj_id)) %>%
    mutate(subj_id = ifelse(subj_id == "kali0604", "subject 10", subj_id)) %>%
  mutate(subj_id = ifelse(subj_id == "kali0628", "subject 11", subj_id)) %>%
  mutate(subj_id = ifelse(subj_id == "kali0640", "subject 12", subj_id)) %>%
  mutate(subj_id = ifelse(subj_id == "kali0650", "subject 13", subj_id)) %>%
  mutate(subj_id = ifelse(subj_id == "kali0651", "subject 14", subj_id)) %>%
  subset(class == "parasitemic") %>%
  ggplot(., aes(x = UMAP_1, y = UMAP_2, color = as.factor(celltype_num))) +
 geom_point(size = 0.5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = label), color = "black", size = 4) +
  xlab("UMAP 1") +
  ylab("UMAP 2") +
  scale_color_manual(
    name = "cell type",
    values = new_colors,

all_umap_by_subj <- plot_grid(all_umap_plot_bysubj_apara,
```

```{r import degs, include=TRUE}
camera_hall_bound_filtered <- camera_hall %>%
```

# b: create faceted volcano plot


```{r volcano plots, fig.align='center', fig.height=6, fig.width=18}

lfc_threshold <- 2
signif_threshold <- 0.005

hallmark_sigs <- read_rds("~/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-IndianaUniversity/Desktop/R21 Sterile Immunity data and scripts/modules for GSEA/MSigDB_Hallmark_v7.4.rds")


hallmark_camera_genes <- c(hallmark_sigs$HALLMARK_WNT_BETA_CATENIN_SIGNALING,
                          hallmark_sigs$HALLMARK_UV_RESPONSE_UP, 
                          hallmark_sigs$HALLMARK_UNFOLDED_PROTEIN_RESPONSE,
                          hallmark_sigs$HALLMARK_TNFA_SIGNALING_VIA_NFKB,
                          hallmark_sigs$HALLMARK_TGF_BETA_SIGNALING,
                          hallmark_sigs$HALLMARK_PROTEIN_SECRETION, 
                          hallmark_sigs$HALLMARK_PI3K_AKT_MTOR_SIGNALING, 
                          hallmark_sigs$HALLMARK_P53_PATHWAY,
                          hallmark_sigs$HALLMARK_OXIDATIVE_PHOSPHORYLATION, 
                          hallmark_sigs$HALLMARK_MYC_TARGETS_V1,
                          hallmark_sigs$HALLMARK_MTORC1_SIGNALING,
                          hallmark_sigs$HALLMARK_MITOTIC_SPINDLE,
                          hallmark_sigs$HALLMARK_INTERFERON_GAMMA_RESPONSE,
                          hallmark_sigs$HALLMARK_INTERFERON_ALPHA_RESPONSE,
                          hallmark_sigs$HALLMARK_INFLAMMATORY_RESPONSE,
                          hallmark_sigs$HALLMARK_IL6_JAK_STAT3_SIGNALING,
                          hallmark_sigs$HALLMARK_IL2_STAT5_SIGNALING,
                          hallmark_sigs$HALLMARK_HYPOXIA,
                          hallmark_sigs$HALLMARK_HEME_METABOLISM,
                          hallmark_sigs$HALLMARK_G2M_CHECKPOINT,
                          hallmark_sigs$HALLMARK_ESTROGEN_RESPONSE_EARLY,
                          hallmark_sigs$HALLMARK_EPITHELIAL_MESENCHYMAL_TRANSITION,
                          hallmark_sigs$HALLMARK_DNA_REPAIR,
                          hallmark_sigs$HALLMARK_COMPLEMENT,
                          hallmark_sigs$HALLMARK_APOPTOSIS,
                          hallmark_sigs$HALLMARK_ANDROGEN_RESPONSE,
                          hallmark_sigs$HALLMARK_ADIPOGENESIS, 
                          "IFNG")
                          
                        

figs8b_volcano_plot <- degs %>%
  bind_rows(., .id = "cell_type") %>%
  dplyr::filter(cell_type %in% levels(factor(camera_hall_bound_filtered$celltype))) %>%
  mutate(lfc_neglogpval = abs(logFC)*-log(P.Value)) %>%
  mutate(dot_color = ifelse(logFC > 0, "up in aparasitemic", "up in parasitemic")) %>%
  mutate(dot_color = ifelse(abs(logFC) < lfc_threshold | P.Value >= signif_threshold, "ns", dot_color)) %>%
  mutate(dot_color = factor(dot_color, levels = c("up in parasitemic", "up in aparasitemic", "ns"))) %>%
  mutate(label = ifelse((P.Value < signif_threshold & abs(logFC) > lfc_threshold & gene_symbol %in% hallmark_camera_genes) | lfc_neglogpval %in% tail(sort(.$lfc_neglogpval), 2) , gene_symbol, "")) %>%
  ggplot(., aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(P.Value))) +
  geom_point(aes(color = dot_color), size = 2.5, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(signif_threshold), color = "gray20", linetype = "dotted") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-2,2), color = "gray20", linetype = "dotted") +
  ylab(bquote(~-log[10] ~ "P value")) +
  xlab(bquote(~log[2] ~ "fold change")) +
 ggrepel::geom_text_repel(aes(label = label), max.overlaps = Inf, size=4) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-10,10), breaks = c(-10, -6, -2, 0, 2, 6, 10)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("up in aparasitemic" = "#58a4cb", "up in parasitemic"= "#e41a1c", "ns" = "gray")) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(margin=margin(t=17.5,b=-25), hjust = 0.05, vjust = -40),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 13),
        legend.position = "top",
        legend.text = element_text(size= 11),
        legend.title = element_blank(),
        plot.margin=unit(c(0.05,0.05,0.05,0.05), "null")) +
  facet_wrap(~cell_type, nrow=2)# +
  #guides(color = guide_legend(nrow = 3), 
                             # override.aes = list(size = 4))

figs8b_volcano_plot

```


# Figure S8c: Import wnn re-clustered nk and monocytes from figure 5 and show per subject distribution

```{r nkmono wnn import, fig.align='center', fig.width=10, fig.height=5}

temp<- tempfile(fileext = ".rds")
dl <- drive_download(
as_id("1hYk-5ndaUTz2aVW4vkm6sGOOvasRyKCP"), path = temp, overwrite = TRUE)
nkmono <- readRDS(file = dl$local_path)

# nkmono <- readRDS("82k_WNN reclustered exvivo NK monos with ALRA.rds") # local

# universally change cluster number to start from 1 instead of zero
Idents(nkmono) <- 'seurat_clusters'

table(Idents(nkmono)) # before changing

nkmono$seurat_clusters <- as.factor(as.numeric(as.character(nkmono$seurat_clusters)) + 1)

Idents(nkmono) <- "seurat_clusters" # reassign

table(nkmono$predicted.celltype.l2, Idents(nkmono)) # check. there are 2cells that are cDC2, remove them

nkmono <- subset(nkmono, subset= predicted.celltype.l2 != "cDC2")

# downsample

table(nkmono$phenotype)

Idents(nkmono) <- 'phenotype'
cell.list.para <- WhichCells(nkmono, idents= "Parasitemic", downsample = 1612)
cell.list.apara <- WhichCells(nkmono, idents= "Aparasitemic")

cell.list <- c(cell.list.apara, cell.list.para)

nkmono.downsampled <- nkmono[, cell.list]

Idents(nkmono.downsampled) <- 'seurat_clusters'
```

```{r nkmono wnn umap plots, fig.align='center', fig.width=18, fig.height=7}
  mutate(subj_id = ifelse(subj_id == "kali0628", "subject 6", subj_id)) %>%
  mutate(subj_id = ifelse(subj_id == "kali0640", "subject 7", subj_id)) %>%
  mutate(subj_id = ifelse(subj_id == "kali0650", "subject 8", subj_id)) %>%
  subset(class == "parasitemic") %>%
  ggplot(., aes(x = wnnUMAP_1, y = wnnUMAP_2, color = factor(ident,levels = as.character(sort(as.numeric(unique(ident))))))) +
  geom_point(alpha=0.6, size=0.5) +
  xlab("UMAP 1") +
  ylab("UMAP 2") +
 scale_color_manual(values = new_colors) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "right",
        legend.margin = margin(),
        legend.spacing.y = unit(0.1, "cm"),
        legend.key.height = unit(0.75, "lines"),
        plot.margin=unit(c(0.1,1,0.1,1), "null"),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 12)) +
  facet_grid2(rows = vars(class), cols = vars(subj_id), strip = strip_para) +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(title="cluster",
                                 nrow = 15,
                                 override.aes = list(size=2.5)))

all_wnn_umap_by_subj <- plot_grid(all_wnnumap_plot_bysubj_apara,
                              all_wnnumap_plot_bysubj_para,
                              nrow = 2,
                              align = 'l',
                              rel_heights = c(1,1))

all_wnn_umap_by_subj -> figure_s8c

all_wnn_umap_by_subj
```
